narration.text: Every field change priced and noticed inside the contract's claim window. This is a chore for the project manager of a forty-person electrical subcontractor on a medical office building, under a subcontract that incorporates AIA A201-2017. Athena works it across 4 portals: Primeline GC, Sitegrid, Dailylog and Estimato. On the bench, she found 6 of 6 eligible items, worth 33,254 dollars and 50 cents of the 33,254 dollars and 50 cents there was to find. All 6 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. Among them: A lobby fixture change already executed as a change order. An exam-room controls change already noticed and under review. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 4 hours, so she was about 89 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
